explanation.question_quote: Approximately 3 weeks ago, he had an anterior ST-elevation myocardial infarction, which was treated with intravenous alteplase.
explanation.sentence: The patient had an anterior ST-elevation myocardial infarction approximately three weeks before this presentation.
Sharp positional chest pain radiating to the shoulder ridge and a scratchy friction rub at the left sternal border point to acute pericarditis.
Widespread concave ST elevations with PR depressions further support pericarditis rather than a ventricular aneurysm.
The three-week delay is typical of Dressler’s syndrome, an autoimmune form of postinfarction pericarditis.
